prompt:
Edit the provided paint_mask_guide.png as a precise-object-edit texture projection atlas. Input 1 is the edit target and authoritative geometry/layout. Input 2 design_reference.png is material/detail reference ONLY; input 3 icon_x8.png is colour reference ONLY (magenta is background).
Output ONE transparent RGBA PNG, 1536x2048 (3:4), same layout and exact silhouettes as input 1. Three columns and FOUR rows of 512 square cells. Rows 1-2 contain five PAINT views FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty. Rows 3-4 repeat the exact five silhouettes for MATERIAL MASK. Crucially the first two views are tiny end-on circular views, NOT upright spears. Row 1 col 3 horizontal points LEFT; row 2 col 1 horizontal points RIGHT; row 2 col 2 vertical points UP. Repeat same arrangement in bottom half. Keep every object in exactly its existing location, size, orientation and outline; do not enlarge, redesign, move or redraw the geometry. All gaps remain transparent. Empty row 2 col 3 and row 4 col 3 stay transparent.
PAINT upper half: unlit base colour of MM9 Abli Duta in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Warm-brown wooden shaft with gold bands, stacked pale-silver and rose-pink upper fittings, gold-red collar and faceted pink-white lance blade. Extrapolate reference surface decoration onto existing guide geometry only; do not change the guide's blade outline to reference silhouette. Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow design reference scaled to each view. No lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights, reflections, glow, aura, ground, outlines or text.
MATERIAL MASK bottom half: same five silhouettes filled only with FLAT pure colours, no shading, texture, outlines or antialiased colour blends inside. #FF0000 every metal including gold/silver/steel; #00FF00 leather/fur; #0000FF cloth/cord/hair; #FFFF00 matte non-metal solid including wood/bone/stone; #000000 gemstone/crystal/glass/pearl/enamel/liquid through glass. Every silhouette pixel gets exactly one of these colours, nothing outside silhouettes. Wood shaft yellow, metal fittings and metal blade red, rose-pink crystal/enamel inlays black. Transparent background, never opaque black or checkerboard. Paint grey objects only.
